brain_proposals.general_rule: Inside a LIVE covering regime (managed-money net at a low 1y-pctile AND still worsening WoW at the last publication), the Monday 06-10 ET catch-up window does NOT generate direction - it TESTS the seam gap. Do not run the window as a fade/extend decision on the gap SIGN; run it as a validation. If the window's own signed-flow-vs-price conviction is NEGATIVE (aggression absorbed against the gap's direction), the gap SURVIVES and the window decides only the intraday share - and the window may print the day's extreme (the LOW on an un-extended rally, the HIGH on an extended one) while still leaving the gap intact. Only a POSITIVE-conviction window move against the gap (aligned aggression delivering price back through it) may overturn it.

Both window-adjacent phases carried NEGATIVE conviction (absorbed sell under rising price: -296/+40 and -561/+220). The blind, running the window as a fade decision on the gap sign, called both DOWN and missed by -2190 and -1210.
